String sortByVividnessAndLuma(List<String> pixels) {
  return pixels
      .map((pixel) => pixel.split('').where((c) => c != ' ')
          .toList())
      .fold<List<int>>(
        [],
        (List<int> result, List<String> components) =>
            [...result, ...components.map(int.parse).toList()])
      )
      .sorted(
        (a, b) => a > b ? -1 : a < b ? 1 : 0,
      )
      .join()
      .replaceAll(RegExp(r'(\d+)(\D+)'), '')
      .split('')
      .reduce((a, b) => a + b);
}

String orderedServerLogs(List<String> logs) {
  return logs
    .map((logLine) => logLine.split(' '))
    .where((parts) =>
        parts.length >= 3 &&
        (int.tryParse(parts[0]) != null && int.tryParse(parts[1]) != null))
    .toList()
    .sort(
      (a, b) => a[2].compareTo(b[2]) == 0
          ? a[1]!.toInt() - b[1]!.toInt()
          : a[2]!.compareTo(b[2]!),
    )
    .fold('', (acc, line) => '$acc${line.join(' ')}\n');
}
